summary: Fixed prune_next_body() and count_pruned_next_ids() in roadmap-integration.sh so a CLI flag segment on a Run line (e.g. '--hard') is preserved verbatim through --prune instead of fusing into the id list and silently dropping an active task. Added 25 new flag-bearing test cases across both roadmap layouts, extended roadmap-format.md's Next Grammar, and redeployed. The full gate set passes except three pre-existing, evidenced, unrelated findings (a hanging literature-extension test suite, a lean-extension doc-lint gap, and a 225B eager-load budget overage), excluded via a documented Reasoned Exclusions record in Phase 5.
